content: The project is hosted at https://github.com/kimihiro64/Robin1984, which has already passed Challenge/Solution comparator and validation scripts. I'm currently running it through some passes to extract candidates for Mathlib contributions closer to their standards and intended namespacing, but I want to make it part of my automation system's initial design patterns, rather than an after the fact restructuring. Any tips on what I could be telling it to prioritize as contributions (and how to structure them)? I also have a repo up that's working through Bombieri-Vinogradov towards the Maynard form of the headline result, but likewise it's going to finish the main results before analyzing what should be extracted for Mathlib. Hopefully my next project will be Mathlib forward thinking. Also need to instruct it to do complete lint passes instead of ignoring the 'optional' things, working on getting that set up as well.
I recommend you aim at upstreaming material to Tau Ceti (which is equipped for AI-written contributions), rather than Mathlib.
